messages:
Priya: heads-up — Snyk flagged a glibc vuln in our base images (distroless-slim variant). We need a rapid rebase + coord on keystore rotation and RBAC changes. Target: patch + canary tomorrow 02:00 UTC.

Kevin: ack. which CVE and which images exactly?

Priya: CVE-2026-0000 (placeholder). Affects libc in rbi-base-ubi:latest and distroless-slim:2025. Minimal rebuild set: base, sidecar, and build-run images.

Maria: I can kick off the bake. Are we rotating cosign key in KMS as part of this?

Sasha: yes — current cosign key is due for rotation. I own the KMS operator role. Plan: create a new key version, grant the image-signer SA access, then use cosign with KMS to sign the artifacts. Need to patch IAM and cluster RBAC briefly.

Aj: for audit/logging: we should ensure keystore access is captured and forwarded (keystore API calls + cosign verify). I'll add an audit rule and a fluentd filter to tag signer ops. Also add an alert for signer failures.

Priya: proposed sequence: 1) Maria builds patched images to staging registry 2) Sasha creates new KMS key version and adds image-signer SA 3) Maria signs with cosign/KMS 4) Canary deploy (5 pods) in staging 5) Verify vuln scan + smoke + audit logs 6) Promote and apply RBAC least-priv for production.

deploy-bot: pipeline "bake-base" queued by Maria at 2026-03-21T18:50:12Z

Maria: kicking bake now:```./scripts/bake.sh --variant=distroless-slim --patch=cve-2026-0000 --output=staging-registry.redwood.internal```

Kevin: question — how do we handle older clusters that don't have the KMS plugin? fallback to legacy signer? We need a concise fallback policy.

Sasha: plan is to keep legacy signer reachable for 12h during cutover. We'll add a rollout circuit-breaker in the rollout config to revert if signers spike errors > 5% for 2m.

Aj: added audit rule: "keystore.access": "info", and log-forwarding rule to tag cosign events. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/3245

Priya: Mike — can you approve the KMS IAM binding for image-signer SA? Need a quick review of ARN + justification.

Mike: I can review briefly. Please paste the exact ARN and minimal justification here.

Priya: ARN: projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/img-signer/cryptoKeys/img-signer-key. Justification in runbook PR: "rotate key to meet FIPS timeline and sign patched base images; need KMS access limited to image-signer SA for sign operations only." PR: https://git.internal/redwood/security/runbooks/287

Sasha: applied IAM binding in dev and staged a keystore access test. RBAC patch PR for cluster rolebinding: https://git.internal/redwood/k8s/pulls/892

Maria: staging canary passed smoke tests and vuln-scan (no builds failing). cosign verify logs in staging: OK.

Kevin: SRE — watch for CPU/latency changes on builder pods during signing. cosign/KMS calls are CPU/IO heavy.

Aj: created alert rule: signer_errors > 0 for 1m -> page SRE. Rule ID: alerting/si-1182.

Priya: scheduling prod cutover: 02:00 UTC tomorrow. I'll send calendar invite and the rollback checklist. Short rollback: revert to previous image tag & re-add legacy signer routing.

Kevin: +1 to rollback path. Also ensure sbom and provenance retained for each image.

Sasha: staging->prod promotion started: tagging images and pushing signed manifests to prod-registry. Will update when push completes.

Maria: push complete. starting prod canary (5 pods).

deploy-bot: rollout started: canary=5, timeout=10m

Aj: audit events present and forwarded. cosign verify events show key version x2. No signer_errors so far.

Priya: great. leave legacy signer enabled for 6 more hours, then revoke. I'll follow up w/ final postmortem and update the runbook.

Kevin: thanks all.

Sasha: quick note — opened follow-up to tighten RBAC for image-signer to exact namespaces: https://git.internal/redwood/k8s/issues/841

Mike: approved IAM binding.

Priya: awesome, closing this thread. :thumbsup:
